description: This file contains functions for manipulating socket addresses (sockaddr), including getting ports, comparing addresses, setting ports, assigning addresses, converting from/to string, and resolving hostnames. It is part of the lighttpd server project.

methods.name: sock_addr_get_port
methods.description: Returns the port number from a sockaddr structure, handling IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_wildcard
methods.description: Checks if the sockaddr address is a wildcard (any address) for IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_family_eq
methods.description: Checks if two sockaddr structures have the same address family.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_port_eq
methods.description: Checks if two sockaddr structures have the same port, considering address family.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq
methods.description: Checks if two sockaddr structures have the same address, considering address family.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq_bits
methods.description: Checks if two sockaddr addresses are equal up to a specified number of bits (subnet mask).

methods.name: sock_addr_set_port
methods.description: Sets the port number in a sockaddr structure.

methods.name: sock_addr_assign
methods.description: Assigns an address and port to a sockaddr structure based on family.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_pton
methods.description: Converts an IP address string to sockaddr structure for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop
methods.description: Converts a sockaddr structure to a human-readable IP address string.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_copy_buffer
methods.description: Copies the IP address string representation of sockaddr into a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends the IP address string representation of sockaddr into a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_stringify_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends a stringified version of sockaddr (including port) into a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_nameinfo_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends hostname or IP address of sockaddr into a buffer, resolving hostname if possible.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_hints
methods.description: Creates sockaddr from string with hostname resolution, handling special cases like localhost.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_numeric
methods.description: Creates sockaddr from numeric IP address string without hostname resolution.
